title: Find where an app is installed on the Mac
summary: List the apps in the Applications folders and search for one by part of its name to see where it is installed. Nothing is opened or changed.

aliases.text: where is my app installed on mac
where are installed programs on macos
find app by name in terminal mac
где находится установленное приложение на маке
как найти приложение по части названия mac

prerequisites: Know a part of the app name

steps.explain: Show the apps in the main Applications folder. Each app appears as a name ending in .app. Look for the app name in this list; if it is not here, try the alternatives.
steps.gui: In Finder press Shift-Command-A to open the Applications folder, or choose Go > Applications from the menu bar.
steps.expect: A list of names ending in .app, for example Safari.app.

alternatives.explain: Show apps installed only for your own user account. The tilde (~) stands for your home folder.
alternatives.expect: A list of .app names, or 'No such file or directory' if this folder does not exist on your Mac.

alternatives.explain: Show the built-in Apple apps, which are kept in the system Applications folder.
alternatives.expect: Built-in apps ending in .app, such as Calculator.app.

steps.explain: Show only the entries whose names contain the text you type. The -i option ignores upper and lower case. No output means no app with that name is in /Applications.

placeholders.name: APP_NAME_PART
placeholders.description: Part of the app name, any letter case

steps.expect: The matching app names, for example Safari.app. Nothing is printed if no app matches.

alternatives.explain: Search the whole Mac with Spotlight, not only the Applications folder, and print the full path of each match. Results can be empty if Spotlight indexing is turned off.

placeholders.name: APP_NAME_PART
placeholders.description: Part of the app name, any letter case

alternatives.expect: Full paths such as /Applications/Safari.app. Paths outside /Applications show apps kept in other folders.
